preconditions.description: The dimensions of the board must be between 1 and 15.
The number of distinct positive numbers required must be between 1 and 7.

preconditions.expression: all(-1 <= board[i][j] <= n*m for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All entries in the board must be between -1 and n*m.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= cost[i][j] <= 100000 for i in range(n) for j in range(m))
preconditions.description: All costs in the cost matrix must be between 1 and 100000.

postconditions.expression: stdout == str(min_cost) if min_cost != -1 else stdout == '-1'
postconditions.description: The output must be the minimum total cost or -1 if the task is impossible.
